Reel Editor sound pack

19 sounds. Use the name on the left in edit.json.

whoosh-in
0.62s · CC0 1.0
Fly in: builds and lands on the moment. For something arriving: a zoom in, a caption or emoji entering.
whoosh-out
0.53s · CC0 1.0
Fly out: starts on the moment and trails away. For something leaving: a zoom back out, a cut away.
whoosh
0.85s · CC0 1.0
Pass-by whoosh, even on both sides. For a cut between two thoughts or a quick move across the frame.

whoosh-long

Slow cinematic sweep, about 2 s in and 2 s out, peaking on the moment. For one big reveal per reel at most.
